title: Oklahoma State Beats Oklahoma 37-33 on November 27, 2021
question: What was the score of the Oklahoma vs. Oklahoma State Bedlam game on November 27, 2021?
answer: On November 27, 2021, No. 7 Oklahoma State beat No. 10 Oklahoma 37-33 in Stillwater. The win snapped the Sooners' six-game Bedlam winning streak and ended their run of six straight Big 12 titles.
summary: On this date in 2021, No. 7 Oklahoma State rallied past No. 10 Oklahoma 37-33 in Stillwater, ending the Sooners' six-year hold on the Big 12 title.
body: On this date in 2021, Bedlam went to Stillwater with No. 10 Oklahoma visiting No. 7 Oklahoma State. The Cowboys won 37-33, their first victory in the series since 2014.

The first half belonged to freshman quarterback Caleb Williams, who threw all three of his touchdown passes before the break as the teams went to halftime tied 24-24. Oklahoma pushed its lead to 33-24 early in the second half after a muffed Cowboy punt set up a touchdown.

Then the game turned. Spencer Sanders broke loose for a 37-yard touchdown run to cut the gap to 33-31. Oklahoma then muffed a punt deep in its own territory, and Jaylen Warren's one-yard touchdown run put Oklahoma State ahead 37-33 with 8:54 remaining. Williams threw for 252 yards in all, but went 6 of 18 for 48 yards after halftime. Kennedy Brooks led the Sooners with 139 rushing yards.

Williams still had a last chance. He ran 56 yards to the Oklahoma State 24-yard line late in the fourth quarter, but the Sooners could not score, and Collin Oliver sacked him on the final play. The loss dropped Oklahoma to 10-2, ended its six straight Big 12 championships, and sent Oklahoma State to the conference title game against Baylor as the top seed.
